origin: floor centre of one standard one-metre module
animation_policy: Draft material panel segments identify belt only. Source-clock texture/stripe motion and payload movement are W runtime gates; no autonomous animation is exported.
reference_comparison: R04 long straight is assembled from repeated1m modules. Single module is deliberately shorter; petrol thick rails, dark substantial belt, connected legs/feet/crossmembers and warm marker plates follow R04. No parcel baked into reusable geometry.
